title: Ticwatch Pro as collector gets unpaired
symptom: When using a Ticwatch Pro as a collector with xDrip, it connects to a Dexcom G6 transmitter the first time, pairs successfully, and receives data, but after about 5 minutes it gets unpaired and no data is received. The issue repeats, requiring re-pairing each time.
evidence_quote: Using ticwatch pro with latest updates and latest nightly release of xdrip when configured to work as collector the first time it connects to dexcom G6 it asks for pairing , I accept , it gets data, all fine, but after 5 minutes when it tries to connect again it gets Unpaired and no data received.
